description: Defines how to call the extension to retrieve a secret from a vault.

allOf.description: The arguments must define exactly one object with the `nameArg` property.
allOf.title: Secret name input argument

allOf.description: The arguments may define at most one object with the `vaultArg` property.
allOf.title: Vault input argument

args.description: The arguments to pass to the command to retrieve a secret. The arguments must define the secret name input argument exactly once and may define the vault input argument at most once.

anyOf.description: A static string argument to pass to the command, like `get` or `--quiet`.

The argument that accepts the secret name. DSC passes the name of the secret to retrieve
after this argument. The arguments must define this argument exactly once.

nameArg.description: The argument that accepts the secret name, like `--name` or `--secret-name`.

anyOf.description:
The argument that accepts the vault name. DSC passes the name of the vault after this
argument when the `secret()` function specifies a vault. The arguments may define this
argument at most once.

vaultArg.description: The argument that accepts the vault name, like `--vault` or `--vault-name`.

args.title: Arguments

executable.description: The name of the command to run to retrieve a secret.
executable.title: Executable
